CAMILA RESTREPO
SENIOR GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER & PAID ACQUISITION LEAD
Miami, FL • (555) 612-4091 • camila.restrepo@example.com • linkedin.com/in/camila-marketing-dummy
MARKETING METRICS
• $12M+ Annual Ad Spend Managed
• 3.4x Blended ROAS Achieved
• 48% Reduced Customer CAC
• 185K+ Net New MQLs Generated
GROWTH TOOLKIT
• Meta Ads Manager & TikTok Ads
• Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube)
• Amplitude, Mixpanel & GA4
• AppsFlyer, Adjust & Branch (MMP)
• Optimizely & VWO (A/B Testing)
• SQL & Tableau Reporting
EDUCATION
B.S. in Digital Marketing & Media
University of Florida (2018)
Summa Cum Laude
EXECUTIVE PROFILE
Data-driven Growth Marketing Manager with 7+ years orchestrating high-scale user
acquisition, performance creative testing, and multi-channel marketing campaigns. Proven
record of scaling direct-to-consumer and mobile subscription brands past $50M in annual
revenue while maintaining strict payback margins.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Performance Marketing Manager — Nova Health App (Miami, FL)
2022 – Present
• Managed $1.1M monthly budget across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Apple Search Ads.
• Built creative testing pipeline producing 40+ iterative ad variations weekly, lowering customer
acquisition cost (CAC) by 42%.
• Partnered with product and engineering teams to optimize subscription paywall conversion by
19%.
Growth Marketing Lead — Solstice Commerce (Austin, TX)
2019 – 2022
• Scaled e-commerce customer base from 25,000 to 220,000 paying users within 24 months.
• Designed multi-touch attribution model in BigQuery & Tableau to track ROAS across paid,
organic, and influencer channels.
